title: nightmill project configuration (.claude/nightmill.json)
description: Everything the nightmill skills and scripts need to know about one project. Unknown keys are ignored.

owner.description: GitHub user or organisation that owns the repository and the project board.

projectNumber.description: Number of the GitHub Projects (v2) board, as in `gh project view N`.

name.description: How the skills address the person who sets Ready and Approved.

board.description: Field and option names on the board. The flow itself is fixed: backlog > ready > spec > specReview > approved > inProgress > review > done.

areas.description: Area options for the issue forms and the board's Area field.

invariants.description: Project rules every story and bug must respect. Rendered as a checkbox list into the issue forms.

check.description: The local equivalent of CI: one command run from the repository root, non-zero exit on failure.

manualCheckPaths.description: A change under one of these paths also needs the manual check.

manualCheckText.description: What the manual check is, in one sentence.

benchRule.description: Optional extra testing rule, for example which code needs a benchmark.

storyTriggers.description: Kinds of change that turn a bug into a story and block auto-merge, for example a new rule, tuning numbers, a wire-format change.

roles.description: The model each agent role runs on. A role that is absent, or whose model is empty, takes the default shown. specReviewer must rank at least as high as specWriter, and codeReviewer at least as high as implementer and fixer (checked by the validator against models.ranking, or its default when it is not set).

specWriter.description: Writes the spec of a Ready story.

model.description: Model alias or full model id.

specReviewer.description: Reviews a spec before it goes to Spec review. Reviews specWriter.

model.description: Model alias or full model id.

tester.description: Writes the failing tests from the approved spec, before the implementer. Not compared with any other role.

model.description: Model alias or full model id.

implementer.description: Writes the code of an Approved story.

model.description: Model alias or full model id.

codeReviewer.description: Reviews the change before the pull request opens. Reviews implementer and fixer.

model.description: Model alias or full model id.
Model alias or full model id.

worker.description: Does mechanical, fully specified jobs (the worker agent).

model.description: Model alias or full model id.

models.description: What nightmill needs to know about models.

ranking.description: Models from weakest to strongest; a model's rank is its position. Name models of the same level in one entry, joined by =, for example "opus=claude-opus-5-5". List the aliases and the full model ids that roles use.

maxFixRounds.description: How many times a producer may fix what its reviewer found before the work is handed to the maintainer. 0 hands over after the first review.

maxAgents.description: Agents (subagents, slot builds) running at the same time on this machine. Rule of thumb: one per 8 GB of RAM.

hotFiles.description: Files or directories only one task may touch at a time.

doNotPair.description: Kinds of tasks that must not run side by side, for example two benchmark-heavy tasks.

maxSuggestedAgents.description: The highest agent limit scripts/load.* suggests (it uses 1 to 99; the suggestion is never below 1). It bounds the suggestion only, not maxAgents or a value set with slot --capacity.

memoryPerAgentGB.description: Memory one agent's work needs, in GB of 10^9 bytes (1 to 1024), for the memory part of the suggestion of scripts/load.*. The default is the rule of thumb /nightmill:init uses: one agent per 8 GB.

loadWindowSeconds.description: How long scripts/load.* measures, in seconds (2 to 60): one CPU and memory sample a second.

roomCheck.description: Whether /next, /spec and /fix check that the machine has room (scripts/room.*: free memory and CPU load) before they start an agent, and wait while it has not. false starts agents as before.

roomMinFreeMB.description: The free memory, in MB of 10^6 bytes (1 to 999999), below which scripts/room.* holds the start of another agent.

roomMaxCpuPercent.description: The CPU load, in percent (1 to 100), above which scripts/room.* holds the start of another agent. 100: the CPU never holds a start.

roomPauseSeconds.description: Seconds scripts/room.* pauses before the next check while there is no room (1 to 90).

roomMaxWaitMinutes.description: The longest a skill waits for room, in minutes (1 to 1440); then it stops that task and starts nothing.

controlMode.description: The load controller (scripts/control.*, /nightmill:control): off does nothing; report measures and prints what it would change, changing nothing; apply raises or lowers the live agent limit (and raises the slot count when needed) with slot --capacity, within controlMinAgents and controlMaxAgents. It never stops an agent.

controlMinAgents.description: The lowest agent limit the load controller sets (1 to 99).

controlMaxAgents.description: The highest agent limit the load controller sets (1 to 99). Its target never exceeds maxSuggestedAgents either.

controlCooldownMinutes.description: Minutes after the last change of the live numbers before the load controller raises the agent limit by one more step or lowers it for CPU (1 to 1440). Short memory lowers it at once.

controlIntervalMinutes.description: How often the load controller should run, in minutes (1 to 1440): the interval for /loop and for an orchestrator. Each pass prints it.

root.description: Where slot worktrees live, relative to the main checkout. Default: ../<checkout-folder>-wt

slots.description: Number of permanent slots. WORKER_SLOTS in the environment overrides it.

stalledAfterMinutes.description: Minutes without a report after which the agent in a busy slot counts as stalled instead of running (slot --status --porcelain, /status). /next and /fix report at each step with slot --report.

dashboardRefreshSeconds.description: How often scripts/dashboard.* rewrites the page in the browser, in seconds (10 to 3600); the page reloads itself as often. Each rewrite reads the board and the pull requests with gh once.

panelRefreshSeconds.description: How often the slots pane beside the chat (/nightmill-slots) reads the slots again while it is open, in seconds (5 to 3600). Each read runs slot --status --porcelain once; no gh call.

ports.description: Port bases by name; slot N gets base + N. Example: {"server": 8100, "client": 5200}.

dir.description: Directory inside the worktree to run in. Default: the worktree root.

lockfile.description: Relative to the worktree. When set, the command runs only when this file's hash changed since the last run in that slot.

warmup.description: Commands that make a slot ready to build, for example npm ci.

runHints.description: Lines printed after a slot is taken. {slot} and {port.<name>} are replaced.
